mostWorthwhile.text: Moving trapped material toward the throat was worthwhile: the planned picture shows how coordinated cilia clear mucus rather than merely trapping particles.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the moving lining to the body was less informative than building the clearance mechanism; the required order was not obvious from the biology alone.

surprise.text: The compatibility feedback showed that the lining had to join the body before macrophages could be added, even though microbes had already reached the air sacs.

arbitrary.text: That ordering felt somewhat arbitrary: macrophages were relevant to the escaped microbes, but could not be combined with the lining directly.

continue.text: I would probably continue for more linked physiological mechanisms, although this chapter's mostly predictable sequence offered few meaningful choices. The planned pictures clarify the defenses, but do not explain how macrophages recognize common microbial features.
